title: Indian Panorama Promotes Inclusive Cinema through Audio Description and Closed Captions at 57th IFFI
subtitle: Over 25 Films at 57th IFFI to Feature Audio Description and Closed Captions
body_text:
Posted On: 27 NOV 2026 3:55PM by PIB Mumbai Release ID: 2342544 Views: 64 A A Print Share X Facebook Instagram WhatsApp Copy Article Link
Read in: English Kannada
Goa, 27 November 2026 Cinema is a universal language, one that brings people together through stories, emotions and experiences. While many experience the magic of cinema through striking frames and unspoken emotions, true inclusivity lies in bringing these unseen moments to life for every member of the audience. Taking this spirit of inclusivity forward, the Indian Panorama section of the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) 2026 is extending the cinematic experience to audiences with diverse accessibility needs. In collaboration with Cinedubs , the initiative is facilitating Audio Description (AD) and Closed Captions (CC) for 25 selected feature films being screened at INOX-2, enabling persons with visual and hearing impairments to engage with the stories in an interesting and meaningful way. This initiative forms part of IFFI's broader efforts to make the festival experience more inclusive for audiences with diverse accessibility needs The 57th IFFI proudly champions Sabka Manoranjan (Entertainment for All), pushing the boundaries to create a festival that celebrates diversity, accessibility, and inclusivity. To capitalise on this vision, the Cinedubs mobile application is allowing audiences to access Audio Description and Closed Captions on their personal smartphones, using headphones during film screenings, making cinema a truly shared experience, accessible to all cinema enthusiasts. Bridging the gap, Audio Description offers narration of key visual details, including actions, settings, facial expressions and other elements that may not be conveyed through dialogue. Meanwhile, bringing the auditory experience to the screen through textual representation of dialogues, sound effects and other relevant audio cues, Closed Captions are making films more accessible to persons with hearing impairments. These features work alongside the regular screening, enabling viewers to follow the film in real time without interrupting the shared cinematic experience. Through this initiative, the Indian Panorama segment at the 57 th IFFI is taking a meaningful step towards ensuring that the magic of cinema can be experienced by everyone, irrespective of their accessibility requirements. The 25 selected feature films being screened under this initiative are: Dhurandhar Urum Thaai Kizhavi Ruby-Cube Banaras Surjyamukhi Sing Geetham Ohh My Dog Pagla Ghora Aadi Anant Laalo - Krishna Sada Sahaayate The Great Grand Superhero Aliens Ka Aagman Baapya Deool Band 2 Krishnavataram Mana Shankara Vara Prasad Garu (Pandaga ki Vastunnaru) Scroll Kabir Sir ka Akhri Lesson Pratyabartan Hanuman Ansh Sev Micchar Sledge The Kerala Story 2 Goes Beyond Chennai Love Story TIGHI By integrating accessibility features into film screenings, Indian Panorama seeks to ensure that sensory barriers do not prevent audiences from experiencing the art of cinema. The initiative also resonates with the theme of IFFI 2026, Stories Without Borders , reaffirming cinema's ability to connect people across differences.
